# Crypto Daily

> Independent reporting on crypto markets, protocols, companies and regulation, with clear explanations of what changed, how it works and why it matters.

Coverage: Markets and Trading, Protocols and Infrastructure, Companies and Funding, Policy and Regulation, Security and Exploits.

## Key pages
- [Homepage](https://cryptoworldnews.github.io/): latest reporting and analysis.
- [About](https://cryptoworldnews.github.io/about/): editorial scope, independence, sourcing and corrections.
- [Archive](https://cryptoworldnews.github.io/archive/): everything published.
